national_latest.source: Pakistan Economic Survey 2025-26 Table 2.3; source PBS

model_note: Ridge regression uses prior national output, the trailing three-season mean, and a time trend. Its penalty is selected on earlier rolling seasons. An outer expanding-window backtest compares it with repeating last season and the three-season mean. The displayed next-season number is a historical benchmark from the lowest-MAE method, not a current crop measurement or a satellite-informed prediction. Province series ends at 2023-24; no later province shares are inferred.

price_analysis.source: Pakistan Bureau of Statistics, Weekly SPI Annex, Appendix A

city_alerts.rule: City price is above its own 90th-percentile historical premium over the national average.
City price is above its own 90th-percentile historical premium over the national average.

price_analysis.alert_note: Alerts describe surveyed city retail prices, not district-wide shortages or future prices. The city premium threshold is calculated from its preceding 48 weekly observations.

price_pattern_reference.coverage_note: One observed year (2025-10-23 to 2026-10-08) — a monthly trajectory, not a confirmed recurring season.

supply_demand_reference.demand_note: Census population multiplied by HIES national household consumption rate; excludes commercial, institutional, export and loss demand. Population and survey years differ.
supply_demand_reference.supply_note: District figures are annual crop production, not monthly harvested or market-arrival volumes. The printed KP province total is one tonne below the sum of its district rows in the source publication.

road_and_season_reference.route_note: Road distances join district and market city centers using OpenStreetMap roads. They do not include farm pickup, market access, freight quotes, truck availability, spoilage, or storage capacity.

source_yield_reference.note: PBS portal district yield history for the four selected source districts, downloaded through a Data Darbar mirror. Their 2023-24 area and output were cross-checked against the MNFSR district publication; Multan's 2024-25 output also matches Punjab Agriculture Department's published 132,258 tonnes. Other 2024-25 district rows lack that independent check here. The mirror omits some districts and 2017-18, so its rows are not national totals. Historical district yield does not replace onion field boundaries or current satellite observations.

satellite_catalog_reference.note: Official Copernicus Sentinel-2 L2A scene metadata near district-center points. Cloud cover is for the satellite tile, not an onion field. No reflectance, NDVI, crop mask, or yield inference is computed.

trade_reference.note: Official PBS commodity-by-country trade report, one cumulative fiscal year. Annual granularity only — not matched to the weekly price series, not a trend (no second machine-readable year retrieved here), and not a supply or price driver claim. Values are PKR thousands as published, with no currency conversion.

crop_classifier.dataset: Field-level Sentinel-2 time series for Pakistan crop classification (Ali et al. 2026)
crop_classifier.ground_truth_source: Asian Development Bank crop-type survey of Pakistan
crop_classifier.split_method: Grouped by District (never by field); 20% of districts held out entirely for test, seed 42.
crop_classifier.rabi_filter_note: Rabi excludes ~118 off-season rarity fields (Cotton/Sorghum/Jantar/Rice, 1-14 samples each) per the dataset authors' own documented filter, matching their published methodology. Kharif is unfiltered.
crop_classifier.model_method: Multinomial (softmax) logistic regression on flattened 7-month x 28-channel Sentinel-2 feature tensor, class-balanced weights, trained by momentum gradient descent in numpy. No external ML framework.
crop_classifier.note: Real ground-truth labels (ADB survey), real Sentinel-2-derived features, a genuine multi-class classifier, and a spatial (district-held-out) evaluation against a majority-class baseline using macro-F1. This is Pakistani agriculture, but field crops (wheat, rice, cotton, sugarcane, etc.), not onions -- no onion labels exist in this dataset. Not used anywhere in the onion Monitor.

potato_satellite.feature: February 11, 2016 NDVI at published sample locations
potato_satellite.outcome: Measured potato yield from harvested 3 m² sample, scaled to t/ha
potato_satellite.validation: Leave one entire field out; train on the other two fields; same ridge penalty 1.0 in each fold; compare with training-field mean. Exploratory model choice needs independent confirmation.
potato_satellite.scope_note: Three nearby fields in one Saudi season are too little evidence for a reliable current forecast, Pakistan transfer, or supply/dispatch decision. One held-out field loses to the simple baseline. Model choices were explored on this dataset, so the measured advantage needs independent confirmation. The displayed points are 2016 held-out evaluations, not live predictions.
